observations: Photo 0 and 1 show an orange 12.5kg-style LPG gas cylinder with a brass/gold-colored valve, sitting among other cylinders (red, blue).
Cylinder body shows visible scratches, scuffed paint, and dirt on the shoulder and handle area.
Photo 2 shows a close-up of the cylinder with printed text including a brand mark 'REPSOL' and a capacity marking that appears to read '12,5' (kg).
No visible date-of-manufacture or next-inspection stamp is legible in any photo.
No photo shows a flame test, soap-bubble leak test, or a weighing/filling scale.
The valve looks intact and not corroded, but its installation date cannot be confirmed from a still photo.

claims.claim: Foreign-Used Gas Cylinder, durable and high-quality
claims.evidence: Brand text 'REPSOL' in photo 2 suggests foreign origin, but overall quality/durability cannot be judged from photos alone.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak
claims.evidence: No test certificate, inspection stamp, or leak-test clip/photo is shown.
Valve appears intact and unmarked by rust in photo 0/1, but no close-up of valve markings or purchase receipt is given to confirm it is new.

risks.risk: Cylinder could be leaking or fail a pressure/leak test despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A clear video of a soap-bubble or flame test at the valve under pressure.
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested, i.e. as a basic used cylinder with no leak guarantee

risks.risk: Cylinder may be past its safety re-certification/inspection date, which affects refill acceptance at stations.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped manufacture/inspection date on the collar or body.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown inspection status, same as an ordinary used cylinder

risks.risk: Valve may not actually be new, and internal thread/seal condition is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of valve markings/date code or a receipt for valve replacement.
risks.if_unproven: priced as original/old valve, not new

risks.risk: Visible dents or corrosion under the worn paint could weaken the cylinder.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the scratched/scuffed areas and the base ring.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn, standard used condition, not 'neatly used'

proof_requests: Video of a leak/pressure test at the valve (soap bubbles or flame).
Clear photo of the date-of-manufacture / next inspection stamp on the cylinder collar.
Close-up of the valve showing any date code or brand marking to support 'new valve' claim.
Photo of the full cylinder body including the base to check for dents/rust not visible in current shots.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used 12.5kg LPG cylinder with a legible foreign brand, but all seller claims (tested, no leak, new valve) are unverified from photos, and visible wear argues against a 'neatly used' grade, so it is priced at the worst-case used-cylinder level.
